metadata.title: Lesson 1: Business requirements, scope and value
metadata.summary: Turn familiarisation evidence into business requirements, a first scope boundary and a value statement for users and the organisation.

metadata.title: Lesson 2: Decomposition and pattern recognition
metadata.summary: Split the Oakridge problem into discrete parts and recognise patterns from existing adult-learning systems without copying the wrong solution.

metadata.title: Lesson 3: Abstraction for a scoped proposal
metadata.summary: Hide detail that does not matter yet so the project proposal stays focused on inputs, outputs, what varies and what stays constant.

metadata.title: Homework: Draft project proposal outline
metadata.summary: Produce a short proposal outline that Week 4 can turn into functional and non-functional requirements, KPIs and acceptance criteria.

metadata.title: Lesson 1: Current and emerging digital technology
metadata.summary: Baseline diagnostic, then define established, current and emerging digital technologies using contemporary examples.

metadata.title: Lesson 2: Classifying technologies across industries
metadata.summary: Classify technology examples and discuss why adoption differs between individuals, organisations and sectors.

metadata.title: Lesson 3: Technology profile and exit check
metadata.summary: Research one emerging technology and complete an exit knowledge check.

metadata.title: Homework: Emerging technologies in everyday life
metadata.summary: Identify three emerging technologies encountered in everyday life and briefly outline their uses.

metadata.title: Lesson 1: What mobile technology is
metadata.summary: Retrieve current versus emerging, then see how mobile technologies combine computing, communication, sensors, applications and internet connectivity.

metadata.title: Lesson 2: Personal and organisational uses
metadata.summary: Compare personal and organisational applications of smartphones, tablets and other mobile devices.

metadata.title: Lesson 3: Organisational mobile case study
metadata.summary: Produce a short case study showing how mobile technology supports a selected organisation.

metadata.title: Homework: Organisational mobile communication
metadata.summary: Investigate how one organisation uses mobile technology to communicate with customers or employees.
